title: The Attentional White Bear Effect in Transformer Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the 'white bear' effect in LLMs, specifically how suppressing a concept can paradoxically maintain or increase its internal representational salience. While the concept library used for probing includes categories like 'religion', 'politics', and 'self-harm', these are used as experimental stimuli to test the mechanics of suppression rather than to evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical systems themselves.
